newsitem.title: UK: Unigate at new high on profits, outlook.
newsitem.headline: Unigate at new high on profits, outlook.

text.p: Shares in British dairy and distribution company Unigate Plc rose on Monday after the company posted a higher-than-expected pre-tax profit and an overall upbeat outlook.
The stock hit a new all-time-high at 505p but retreated afterwards to 498p, up 1-1/2, by 0820 GMT.
"The figures were above expectations. We still believe Unigate will continue to outperform the market", a trader said.

Earlier the company reported a pretax pre-exceptional profit of 129.6 million pounds, while analysts had put the upper range at 128 million pounds. The new year had started "reasonably well" in a very competitive market, Unigate said.
